//: Publish build ONLY (scripts/pack-core.ts). The checked-in package.json exports point at src/*.ts because in-repo consumers import source with no build step; this config emits the compiled ESM + .d.ts that the npm tarball ships instead. rewriteRelativeImportExtensions turns the source's explicit `.ts` specifiers into `.js` in the emitted output. No rootDir: TS infers packages/core/ as the common root, so src/ and the schema/*.json that validate.ts imports both land under outDir with their relative paths intact (../schema/x.json still resolves from src/).
